QuestInfo.name: [Mr. Lee Airlines] Helmsman Gorilla Rescue
QuestInfo.0: The Feline Pirate Ship was wrecked, and its crew members were scattered. Look for Helmsman Gorilla.
QuestInfo.1: Helmsman Gorilla has agreed to return to the pirate ship if you help him.
QuestInfo.2: You now have a helmsman for the Feline Pirate Ship.
